step.root_cause: App used 0ms conversion wait, reading before sensor finished conversion so busy flag stayed set and data was stale
step.fix: Set conversion_wait_ms to 10 to satisfy >=5ms conversion time

observations: REFUSED: reviewer: Finding 2 overreach: quote says "data may be stale" (conditional warning), not that sensor definitively reported stale data; reviewer: Finding 3 overreach: quote only defines "5 (Busy flag) 1 = device is busy"; it does not state that busy means data not yet available; reviewer: Finding 4 overreach: quote presents "Option 2: Wait for at least 5 ms" as one option, not a mandatory "Must wait" requirement

step.root_cause: App used 0ms conversion wait, reading while busy flag set per Option 2 timing guidance
step.fix: Set conversion_wait_ms to 10 to cover Option 2 5ms conversion guidance
